audioRequiredUz: 19-mashqda SAVOLLAR bosilmagan — faqat ikkitadan javob varianti berilgan. Grammatik jihatdan faqat 4-band aniqlanadi ('Yes, I loved' — noto'g'ri ingliz tili). Qolgan 11 band FAQAT AUDIODAN aniqlanadi; har biri uchun 'qaysi savolga qaysi javob mos keladi' tahlili berildi, lekin taxmin bilan to'ldirilmadi. 21-mashq esa AUDIOSIZ TO'LIQ yechiladi — 'sh' va 'ch' yozilishi tovushni aniq belgilaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: You are going to listen to some short exchanges. Read the possible responses, then listen and choose the best answer. — the item that grammar alone decides
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa savol-javoblarni tinglaysiz. Mumkin bo'lgan javoblarni o'qing, so'ngra tinglab eng to'g'ri javobni tanlang. — grammatikaning o'zi hal qiladigan band
exercises.explanationUz:
MAShQNING TUZILIShI:
  Kitobda SAVOLLAR bosilmagan — faqat
  ikkitadan JAVOB varianti berilgan.
  Savollar audioda aytiladi.

  Shuning uchun ko'p bandni faqat tinglab
  aniqlash mumkin.

  LEKIN 4-band ISTISNO: uning bir varianti
  GRAMMATIK JIHATDAN NOTO'G'RI, shuning
  uchun savolni bilmasdan ham javob aniq.


4-BAND:
  a) Yes, I loved it.   ✓
  b) Yes, I loved.      ✗ NOTO'G'RI!


NEGA b) NOTO'G'RI:

  'to LOVE' — O'TIMLI fe'l, ya'ni undan
  keyin TO'LDIRUVCHI kelishi SHART:

     'I love IT.'       ✓
     'I love MUSIC.'    ✓
     'I love YOU.'      ✓
     'I loved.'         ✗ (nimani?)

  Ingliz tilida ba'zi fe'llar to'ldiruvchisiz
  ishlatilmaydi.


SHU KABI O'TIMLI FE'LLAR:
  like, love, hate, want, need, enjoy,
  buy, take, make, put

  'I like.'      ✗   →  'I like it.'      ✓
  'I want.'      ✗   →  'I want it.'      ✓
  'I enjoyed.'   ✗   →  'I enjoyed it.'   ✓


O'TIMSIZ FE'LLAR (to'ldiruvchisiz ham
bo'ladi):
  go, come, sleep, arrive, laugh, cry

  'I slept.'     ✓
  'She arrived.' ✓


DEMAK 4-BAND UChUN AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Savol qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar,
  'Yes, I loved.' — noto'g'ri ingliz tili.

  Javob: a) Yes, I loved it.

  (Savol, ehtimol: 'Did you like the film?'
   yoki 'What was the museum like?')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an exchange = qisqa savol-javob
  a response  = javob
  possible    = mumkin bo'lgan

items.textEn: 4  a) Yes, I loved it.   b) Yes, I loved.
items.whyUz:
⚠ AUDIO SHART EMAS — b) varianti GRAMMATIK
JIHATDAN NOTO'G'RI.

'to LOVE' — O'TIMLI fe'l, undan keyin
TO'LDIRUVCHI kelishi SHART:
  'I loved IT.'  ✓
  'I loved.'     ✗ (nimani?)

Shu kabi fe'llar: like, want, need, enjoy,
buy, take, make.

Savol qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, javob
a) bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Ex. 19 — the eleven items that need the recording, with an analysis of which question each response answers
exercises.instructionUz: 19-mashq — audio kerak bo'lgan o'n bir band, har javob qaysi savolga mos kelishi tahlili bilan
exercises.explanationUz:
OChIQ QOLGAN 11 BAND

Kitobda savollar bosilmagani uchun bu
bandlarni faqat tinglab aniqlash mumkin.
TAXMIN BILAN TO'LDIRILMADI.

Lekin quyida har javob QAYSI SAVOLGA mos
kelishi tahlil qilingan — audioni
tinglaganda darhol tanlay olasiz.


 1  a) I'd love to.      b) I like it.

    a) — TAKLIFGA javob
       Savol: 'Would you like to come?' /
              'Shall we go out?'
       ('I'd love to' = juda xohlardim)
    b) — FIKR so'ralganda
       Savol: 'How do you like it?' /
              'What do you think of it?'

    KALIT: savol TAKLIFmi yoki FIKRmi?


 2  a) Two weeks ago.    b) Since Monday.

    a) — 'WHEN did you ...?' (Past Simple)
       'ago' → aniq o'tmish nuqtasi
    b) — 'HOW LONG have you ...?'
       (Present Perfect)
       'since' → boshlanish nuqtasi

    KALIT: savol 'WHEN did' mi yoki
           'HOW LONG have' mi?
    (107-betdagi for/since qoidasi!)


 3  a) Yes, I can.       b) Yes, please.

    a) — 'CAN you ...?' (qobiliyat/iltimos)
       Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni
       takrorlaydi.
    b) — TAKLIFGA rozilik
       Savol: 'Would you like some tea?' /
              'Can I help you?'

    KALIT: savol QOBILIYAT haqidami yoki
           TAKLIFmi?


 5  a) Yes, you have.    b) Yes, you do.

    a) — 'HAVE I ...?' savoliga
       ('Have I got time?')
    b) — 'DO I ...?' savoliga
       ('Do I have to pay?')

    KALIT: savol 'HAVE' bilanmi yoki 'DO'
           bilanmi boshlangan?


 6  a) You must.         b) Of course.

    a) — 'MUST I ...?' savoliga
       ('Must I go now?' → 'Yes, you must.')
    b) — RUXSAT so'ralganda
       ('Can I use your phone?' →
        'Of course.')

    KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
           RUXSATmi?


 7  a) In the spring.    b) Cairo.

    a) — 'WHEN ...?' (vaqt)
    b) — 'WHERE ...?' (joy)

    KALIT: savol 'WHEN' mi yoki 'WHERE' mi?
    Eng oddiy band — faqat savol so'zini
    eshitish yetarli.


 8  a) Yes, I have.      b) Yes, I tried.

    a) — 'HAVE you ...?' savoliga
       ('Have you tried paella?')
       Qisqa javob 'have' ni takrorlaydi.
    b) — 'DID you ...?' savoliga
       (lekin standart javob 'Yes, I DID'
        bo'lardi)

    KALIT: savol 'HAVE you' mi yoki
           'DID you' mi?
    DIQQAT: a) — standart qisqa javob;
    b) shakli kamroq uchraydi.


 9  a) I won't.          b) That's a good idea.

    a) — OGOHLANTIRIShGA javob
       ('Don't be late!' → 'I won't.')
    b) — TAKLIFGA rozilik
       ('Why don't we go to the cinema?' →
        'That's a good idea.')

    KALIT: savol OGOHLANTIRIShmi yoki
           TAKLIFmi?


10  a) Sorry, you can't.  b) No, you shouldn't.

    a) — 'CAN I ...?' savoliga (ruxsat rad
       etiladi)
    b) — 'SHOULD I ...?' savoliga (maslahat)

    KALIT: savol 'CAN I' mi yoki 'SHOULD I' mi?
    (Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni
     takrorlaydi.)


11  a) Yes, you do.       b) Sorry, you mustn't.

    a) — 'DO I have to ...?' savoliga
       ('Do I have to pay?' → 'Yes, you do.')
    b) — 'CAN I ...?' yoki 'MAY I ...?'
       savoliga (taqiq)

    KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
           RUXSAT so'rashmi?


12  a) Of course you can't. b) Of course you can.

    Ikkalasi ham 'CAN I ...?' savoliga javob,
    faqat biri RAD etadi, biri RUXSAT beradi.

    KALIT: bu bandni FAQAT audiodan aniqlash
    mumkin — savolning MAZMUNI hal qiladi
    (masalan, 'Can I borrow your pen?' →
     'Of course you can'; 'Can I smoke here?'
     → 'Of course you can't').


⚠ UMUMIY OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB
SAVOLDAGI YORDAMChI/MODAL FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI:

     'HAVE you ...?'      →  'Yes, I HAVE.'
     'DO you ...?'        →  'Yes, I DO.'
     'CAN I ...?'         →  'Yes, you CAN.'
     'MUST I ...?'        →  'Yes, you MUST.'
     'SHOULD I ...?'      →  'No, you
                              SHOULDN'T.'
     'DID you ...?'       →  'Yes, I DID.'

  Bu qoida 5, 8, 10, 11-bandlarni hal qiladi —
  faqat savolning BIRINChI SO'ZINI eshitish
  yetarli!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  I'd love to      = juda xohlardim
  Of course        = albatta
  That's a good idea = yaxshi fikr
  Sorry, you can't = kechirasiz, bo'lmaydi

TAKLIFmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

points.uz: 5  a) Ha, bor — 'Menda ... bormi?'  b) Ha — 'Men ... qilishim kerakmi?'
points.noteUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
TAKRORLAYDI — savolning BIRINCHI so'zini

points.uz: 6  a) Kerak — 'Men ... qilishim shartmi?'  b) Albatta — RUXSAT berish.

KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
RUXSATmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

points.uz: 7  a) Bahorda — 'Qachon ...?'  b) Qohira — 'Qayerda ...?'
points.noteUz:
ENG ODDIY BAND: faqat savol so'zini
('when' yoki 'where') eshitish yetarli.
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

points.uz: 8  a) Ha, qildim — 'Siz ...ganmisiz?'  b) Ha, yeb ko'rdim — 'Siz ...dingizmi?'
points.noteUz:
a) — STANDART qisqa javob ('Have you ...?'
ga).
b) shakli kamroq uchraydi (odatda
'Yes, I DID' deyiladi).
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

points.en: 9  a) I won't. — answers a warning ('Don't be late!').   b) That's a good idea. — accepts a suggestion.
points.uz: 9  a) Qilmayman — OGOHLANTIRISHGA javob.  b) Yaxshi fikr — TAKLIFGA rozilik.
points.noteUz:
KALIT: savol OGOHLANTIRISHmi yoki TAKLIFmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

points.uz: 10  a) Kechirasiz, bo'lmaydi — 'Men ...sam bo'ladimi?'  b) Yo'q, kerak emas — 'Men ...ishim kerakmi?'
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javob savoldagi MODALNI takrorlaydi:
'CAN I?' → 'you CAN'T';

AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

points.uz: 11  a) Ha, shart — 'Men ...ishim shartmi?'  b) Kechirasiz, mumkin emas — TAQIQ.
points.noteUz:
KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
RUXSAT so'rashmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

Bu bandni FAQAT audiodan aniqlash mumkin —
grammatika yordam bermaydi, savolning
MAZMUNI kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbatma-navbat ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (12 ta so'z/ibora) — Unit 15 ning
barcha asosiy lug'ati:

  camel, since, have visited, souvenirs,
  traditional, returning, drive, yet,
  already, tip, bellboy, book a table


HAR BIRI UChUN NAMUNA GAP:

 1  CAMEL (tuya)
    'I even rode a CAMEL near the Pyramids.'
    (105-bet, Jekning xatidan)

 2  SINCE (... dan beri)
    'I've been here SINCE Monday.'
    (107-bet, for/since qoidasi)

 3  HAVE VISITED (borganman)
    'I HAVE VISITED the Prado Museum.'
    (107-bet, Madrid dialogidan)

 4  SOUVENIRS (sovg'alar)
    'I bought some lovely handmade SOUVENIRS
     at the bazaar.'
    (105-bet)

 5  TRADITIONAL (an'anaviy)
    'We've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant.'
    (105-bet)

 6  RETURNING (qaytish)
    'I'm RETURNING to England on Sunday next
     week.'
    (105-bet, xatning oxiri)

 7  DRIVE (haydamoq)
    'Have you ever DRIVEN a bus?'
    (106-bet, 12-mashq)
    'No, I've never DRIVEN a bus.'

 8  YET (hali)
    'I haven't been on a boat trip YET.'
    (105 va 106-betlar)

 9  ALREADY (allaqachon)
    'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'
    (105 va 106-betlar)

10  TIP (choychaqa)
    'It's a good idea to TIP a bellboy at
     least $5.'
    (108-bet)

11  BELLBOY (mehmonxona xizmatchisi)
    'Tip your BELLBOY generously and you'll
     have the perfect holiday.'
    (108-bet)

12  BOOK A TABLE (stol band qilmoq)
    'I'd like to BOOK A TABLE for tonight,
     please.'
    (107 va 108-betlar)


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT BUTUN UNITNI QAMRAB OLADI:
  1, 4, 5, 6  →  105-bet (Jekning xati)
  2, 8, 9     →  106-107-betlar (grammatika)
  3, 7        →  106-107-betlar (Present
                 Perfect mashqlari)
  10, 11      →  108-bet (Tipping in America)
  12          →  107-108-betlar (muloqot)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE VISITED' RO'YXATDA:
  Bu — YAGONA to'liq fe'l shakli
  (qolganlari alohida so'zlar).

  Kitob ataylab Present Perfect shaklini
  bergan — o'quvchi uni to'g'ri gapda
  ishlatishi kerak:
     'I have visited ...'  ✓
     'I have visited yesterday.'  ✗
       (aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect
        ishlatilmaydi!)


DIQQAT — 'DRIVE' NING ShAKLLARI:
  drive → drove → DRIVEN

  Present Perfect da: 'I have DRIVEN'
  Past Simple da:     'I DROVE'


O'YIN QOIDALARI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • NAVBATMA-NAVBAT ('take it in turns')
  • Har to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochko — g'olib


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a team    = jamoa
  a point   = ochko
  a winner  = g'olib

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va ✓ qo'ying. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI JADVAL, HAR BIRIDA IKKI USTUN:
  /ʃ/   va   /tʃ/

SAKKIZ SO'Z:
  shoes, choose, watch, wash,
  wish, witch, sheet, cheat


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  shoes   →  /ʃ/
  choose  →  /tʃ/
  watch   →  /tʃ/
  wash    →  /ʃ/
  wish    →  /ʃ/
  witch   →  /tʃ/
  sheet   →  /ʃ/
  cheat   →  /tʃ/

  Ya'ni: /ʃ/ — shoes, wash, wish, sheet
         /tʃ/ — choose, watch, witch, cheat

  To'rttadan teng!


⚠ AUDIO ShART EMAS — YOZILIShI TOVUShNI
BELGILAYDI:

  'SH' harflari      →  /ʃ/
     shoes, wash, wish, sheet

  'CH' yoki 'TCH'    →  /tʃ/
     choose, cheat, watch, witch

  Qoida deyarli hech qachon buzilmaydi.


IKKI TOVUSh QANDAY ChIQARILADI:

  /ʃ/  — 'Sh' tovushi (o'zbekcha 'sh' bilan
         bir xil)
         'shoes' = 'shu:z'
         'wash'  = 'vosh'
         Havo uzluksiz chiqadi.

  /tʃ/ — 'Ch' tovushi (o'zbekcha 'ch' bilan
         bir xil)
         'choose' = 'chu:z'
         'watch'  = 'voch'
         Til birdan uzilib, 'portlash' bo'ladi.

  FARQI: /tʃ/ — /t/ + /ʃ/ birikmasi,
  shuning uchun boshida QISQA to'siq bor.


JUFTLIKLAR — ATAYLAB TANLANGAN:

  Kitob so'zlarni JUFT qilib bergan —
  faqat bir tovush bilan farq qiladi:

     shoes  /ʃuːz/    ↔  choose /tʃuːz/
     wash   /wɒʃ/     ↔  watch  /wɒtʃ/
     wish   /wɪʃ/     ↔  witch  /wɪtʃ/
     sheet  /ʃiːt/    ↔  cheat  /tʃiːt/

  Bunday juftliklar 'minimal juftlik'
  deyiladi — faqat BITTA tovush farq qiladi.

  Agar tovushni noto'g'ri aytsangiz,
  BOShQA so'z chiqadi!


MA'NOLARI:
  shoes  = tuflilar, oyoq kiyim
  choose = tanlamoq
  wash   = yuvmoq
  watch  = soat; tomosha qilmoq
  wish   = tilak; xohlamoq
  witch  = jodugar
  sheet  = choyshab; varaq
  cheat  = aldamoq, nusxa ko'chirmoq


DIQQAT — 'TCH' YOZILIShI:
  Qisqa unlidan keyin 'ch' o'rniga 'TCH'
  yoziladi:
     watch, witch, catch, match, kitchen

  Uzun unli yoki undoshdan keyin faqat 'ch':
     teach, church, beach


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  /ʃ/ (sh):
     she, ship, shop, short, show,
     fish, English, Spanish, sure*
     (*'sure' — 's' bilan yozilsa ham /ʃ/)

  /tʃ/ (ch):
     child, chair, cheese, chicken,
     teacher, kitchen, lunch, much,
     question*
     (*'question' — 'ti' /tʃ/ beradi)


BOG'LIQLIK — UNIT 14:
  Grammar 61-bet, 4-mashqda 'CHEAT' so'zi
  bor edi: 'You mustn't cheat in tests.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to choose = tanlamoq
  a witch   = jodugar
  a sheet   = choyshab; varaq
  to cheat  = aldamoq

items.whyUz:
'SH' harflari → /ʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /ʃuːz/ — 'shu:z'

JUFTI: 'choose' /tʃuːz/ — faqat birinchi
tovush bilan farq qiladi.

'CH' harflari → /tʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /tʃuːz/ — 'chu:z'

JUFTI: 'shoes' /ʃuːz/.
DIQQAT: 'choose' — hozirgi zamon;
'chose' — o'tgan zamon (o'qilishi boshqa).

'TCH' harflari → /tʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /wɒtʃ/ — 'voch'

JUFTI: 'wash' /wɒʃ/.

DIQQAT — 'TCH' YOZILISHI: qisqa unlidan
keyin 'ch' o'rniga 'tch' yoziladi
(watch, catch, match, kitchen).

'SH' harflari → /ʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /wɒʃ/ — 'vosh'

JUFTI: 'watch' /wɒtʃ/ — faqat oxirgi tovush
bilan farq qiladi.

Workbook 57-betda ham bor edi:
'wash the dishes'.

'SH' harflari → /ʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /wɪʃ/ — 'vish'

JUFTI: 'witch' /wɪtʃ/.

'Best wishes' — xat oxirida ishlatiladi
(105 va 108-betlar).

'TCH' harflari → /tʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /wɪtʃ/ — 'vich'

JUFTI: 'wish' /wɪʃ/.

DIQQAT: 'witch' (jodugar) va 'which'
(qaysi) — bir xil o'qiladi /wɪtʃ/, lekin
yozilishi va ma'nosi BOSHQA!

'SH' harflari → /ʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /ʃiːt/ — 'shi:t'

JUFTI: 'cheat' /tʃiːt/.

'a sheet of paper' = bir varaq qog'oz.

'CH' harflari → /tʃ/ tovushi.
O'qilishi: /tʃiːt/ — 'chi:t'

JUFTI: 'sheet' /ʃiːt/.

Grammar 61-bet, 4-mashqda bor edi:
'You mustn't CHEAT in tests.'

sections.title: Writing (a friendly letter from a holiday destination)

exercises.instructionEn: When we are on holiday and we want to write to a friend to report our experiences, we start by saying where we are, when we arrived there, what the weather is like, and where we are staying. Then, we talk about the things we have or haven't done (present perfect), when we did them and what each was like (past simple). We also say what we are going to do. We end the letter by saying what we think of the place and when we are leaving.
exercises.instructionUz: Ta'tilda bo'lganimizda do'stimizga tajribalarimiz haqida yozmoqchi bo'lsak, qayerdaligimiz, u yerga qachon kelganimiz, havo qandayligi va qayerda turganimizni aytishdan boshlaymiz. So'ngra qilgan yoki qilmagan ishlarimiz (present perfect), ularni qachon qilganimiz va har biri qanday bo'lgani (past simple) haqida gapiramiz. Yana nima qilmoqchi ekanimizni ham aytamiz. Xatni joy haqidagi fikrimiz va qachon ketishimiz bilan tugatamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOZISh QUTISI — XATNING TUZILIShI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA UCh QISMDAN IBORAT:


1) BOShLANISh (start) — TO'RT narsa:
     • WHERE WE ARE       (qayerdamiz)
     • WHEN WE ARRIVED    (qachon keldik)
     • WHAT THE WEATHER IS LIKE
                          (havo qanday)
     • WHERE WE ARE STAYING
                          (qayerda turibmiz)

2) ASOSIY QISM (then):
     • THINGS WE HAVE / HAVEN'T DONE
       →  PRESENT PERFECT
     • WHEN WE DID THEM
       →  PAST SIMPLE
     • WHAT EACH WAS LIKE
       →  PAST SIMPLE
     • WHAT WE ARE GOING TO DO
       →  BE GOING TO

3) YAKUN (end):
     • WHAT WE THINK OF THE PLACE
       (joy haqida fikrimiz)
     • WHEN WE ARE LEAVING
       (qachon ketamiz)


⚠ ENG MUHIM — ZAMONLAR TAQSIMOTI:

  QILGAN/QILMAGAN ishlar  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've already visited ...'
     'I haven't been ... yet.'

  QAChON qilgan            →  PAST SIMPLE
     'I went there on Tuesday.'

  QANDAY bo'lgan           →  PAST SIMPLE
     'It was fantastic.'

  REJA                     →  BE GOING TO
     'We are going to visit the museum.'

  Bu — 105-betdagi Jekning xatining aynan
  tuzilishi!


MODEL: 105-BETDAGI JEKNING XATI

  Kitob aytadi: 'Use the letter in Ex. 4 as
  a model.'

  Jekning xatini qayta ko'rib chiqing —
  u bu qoidaning har bandini bajaradi:

     'Greetings from CAIRO!'          (qayerda)
     'I've been here SINCE MONDAY'    (qachon)
     'The weather is VERY HOT'        (havo)
     'I'm STAYING WITH my friend'     (qayerda
                                       turadi)
     'I've ALREADY VISITED ...'       (qilgan)
     'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY'       (qachon)
     'how NOISY AND CROWDED it WAS'   (qanday)
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN ... YET'         (qilmagan)
     'We ARE GOING TO VISIT ...'      (reja)
     'Cairo is a FASCINATING city'    (fikri)
     'I'm RETURNING on Sunday'        (qachon
                                       ketadi)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a destination = manzil, boradigan joy
  to report     = xabar bermoq
  an experience = tajriba, boshdan kechirilgan
                  voqea
  friendly      = do'stona

1-XATBOSHI — TO'RT narsa.
105-betdagi Jekning xati aynan shunday
boshlanadi.

points.uz: So'ngra qilgan yoki qilmagan ishlarimiz (present perfect), ularni qachon qilganimiz va har biri qanday bo'lgani (past simple) haqida gapiramiz.

points.uz: Yana nima qilmoqchi ekanimizni ham aytamiz.

Jek: 'Cairo is a fascinating city' +

exercises.instructionEn: Imagine you are on holiday. Use the plan below to write a letter to a friend telling him/her about your holiday (80-120 words). Use the letter in Ex. 4 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Ta'tildasiz deb tasavvur qiling. Quyidagi rejadan foydalanib, do'stingizga ta'tilingiz haqida xat yozing (80-120 so'z). 4-mashqdagi xatni namuna sifatida oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Dear + (do'stingizning ismi,)

  KIRISh (Introduction)
  1-xatboshi:  Where are you?
               When did you arrive there?
               What is the weather like?
               Where are you staying?

  ASOSIY QISM (Main Body)
  2-xatboshi:  What things have you done?
               When did you do them?
               What was each like?

  3-xatboshi:  What haven't you done yet?
               What are you going to do?

  YAKUN (Conclusion)
  4-xatboshi:  What do you think of the place?
               When are you leaving?

  Best wishes/Love, etc
  (o'z ismingiz)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT (≈115 so'z):

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  Dear Aziz,

  Greetings from Istanbul! I arrived here last
  Tuesday and I'm having a wonderful time. The
  weather is warm and sunny. I'm staying at a
  small hotel near the Blue Mosque.

  I've already done a lot of things. I've
  visited the Topkapi Palace — I went there on
  Wednesday and it was amazing. I've also been
  to the Grand Bazaar. I went there yesterday
  and bought some handmade souvenirs. It was
  very noisy and crowded!

  I haven't been on a boat trip on the
  Bosphorus yet, and I haven't tried Turkish
  coffee. We are going to do both tomorrow.

  Istanbul is a fascinating city — you must
  visit it one day! I'm returning home on
  Sunday.

                            Best wishes,
                            Nodir
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Aziz,

  Istanbuldan salom! Bu yerga o'tgan seshanba
  kuni keldim va ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman.
  Havo iliq va quyoshli. Ko'k masjid yonidagi
  kichik mehmonxonada turibman.

  Allaqachon ko'p ish qildim. To'pqopi
  saroyiga borganman — u yerga chorshanba kuni
  bordim va hayratlanarli edi. Katta bozorga
  ham borganman. U yerga kecha bordim va
  qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib oldim. Juda
  shovqinli va gavjum edi!

  Hali Bosfor bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat
  qilmadim va turk qahvasini yeb ko'rmadim.
  Ertaga ikkalasini ham qilamiz.

  Istanbul — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib
  albatta borishing kerak! Yakshanba kuni
  uyga qaytaman.

                    Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
                    Nodir
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


SO'Z HISOBI:
  Namuna xat ≈115 so'z — talab qilingan
  80-120 oralig'ida.

  Har xatboshi ≈25-30 so'z bo'lsa yetarli.


⚠ HAR XATBOShIDA QAYSI ZAMON:

  1-xatboshi:
     'I ARRIVED here last Tuesday'
        → PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt)
     'I'M HAVING a wonderful time'
        → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir)
     'The weather IS warm'
        → PRESENT SIMPLE
     'I'M STAYING at a hotel'
        → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (vaqtinchalik)

  2-xatboshi:
     'I've ALREADY DONE a lot of things'
        → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've VISITED the Topkapi Palace'
        → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I WENT there ON WEDNESDAY'
        → PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt)
     'it WAS amazing'
        → PAST SIMPLE (baho)

  3-xatboshi:
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN ... YET'
        → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR
     'We ARE GOING TO DO both tomorrow'
        → BE GOING TO (reja)

  4-xatboshi:
     'Istanbul IS a fascinating city'
        → PRESENT SIMPLE (fikr)
     'I'M RETURNING home on Sunday'
        → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (aniq reja)


FOYDALI IBORALAR — HAR XATBOShI UChUN:

  1-XATBOShI:
     'Greetings from [shahar]!'
     'I arrived here last [kun].'
     'I'm having a wonderful time.'
     'The weather is [sifat].'
     'I'm staying at/with ...'

  2-XATBOShI:
     'I've already visited ...'
     'I've also been to ...'
     'I went there on [kun].'
     'It was [sifat].'

  3-XATBOShI:
     'I haven't ... yet.'
     'We are going to ... tomorrow.'

  4-XATBOShI:
     '... is a fascinating city.'
     'You must visit it one day!'
     'I'm returning home on [kun].'
     'Best wishes,' / 'Love,'


DIQQAT — 'BEST WISHES' va 'LOVE':
  'Best wishes,'  — do'st, tanish
  'Love,'         — yaqin do'st, oila
  'Yours,'        — neytral

  Rasmiy xatda: 'Yours sincerely,' /
  'Yours faithfully,'


DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  'Dear Aziz,'      — vergul bilan
  'Best wishes,'    — vergul bilan
  Keyin ism keyingi qatorda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an introduction = kirish
  the main body   = asosiy qism
  a conclusion    = yakun
  to leave        = ketmoq
  a destination   = manzil

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL:


 1  'HE TRAVELS FASTEST WHO TRAVELS ALONE.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Yolg'iz sayohat qilgan eng tez
     sayohat qiladi.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin ma'no:
    'Yolg'iz yurgan tez yetar.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Yolg'iz odam boshqalarni kutmaydi,
    kelishmaydi, muhokama qilmaydi —
    shuning uchun tezroq harakat qiladi.

    Keng ma'noda: hamroh yoki sherik bo'lsa,
    qaror sekinlashadi.

    GRAMMATIKASI — G'ALATI SO'Z TARTIBI:
       Odatdagi tartib:
          'He WHO travels alone travels
           fastest.'
       Maqolda esa:
          'He travels fastest WHO travels
           alone.'

       'who travels alone' ergash gapi
       gap OXIRIGA ko'chirilgan — she'riy,
       ta'sirchan bo'lishi uchun.

       'HE WHO ...' — 'kimki ...' degan
       eskicha qurilma (maqollarda ko'p
       uchraydi).

    Kelib chiqishi: Rudyard Kiplingning
    'The Winners' she'ridan (1890).


 2  'TRAVEL BROADENS THE MIND.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Sayohat ongni kengaytiradi.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin maqol:
    'Ko'p yurgan ko'p biladi.'
    'Ko'p o'qigandan ko'p yurgan afzal.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Yangi joylarni ko'rish, boshqa
    madaniyatlar bilan tanishish odamning
    dunyoqarashini kengaytiradi, fikrini
    o'zgartiradi.

    GRAMMATIKASI:
       'TRAVEL' — bu yerda OT va
       SANALMAYDIGAN (umumiy ma'noda
       'sayohat qilish'), shuning uchun
       artikl YO'Q va fe'l -S oladi:
          'Travel BROADENS ...'  ✓
          'Travels broaden ...'  ✗

       'to BROADEN' = kengaytirmoq
       broad (keng) + -EN (fe'l yasovchi)

       'the MIND' = ong, aql
       'the' bilan — umumiy tushuncha
       sifatida.


DIQQAT — '-EN' FE'L YASOVChI QO'ShIMChA:
  broad  →  broadEN   (kengaytirmoq)
  wide   →  widEN     (kengaytirmoq)
  short  →  shortEN   (qisqartirmoq)
  strong →  strengthEN (mustahkamlamoq)
  deep   →  deepEN    (chuqurlashtirmoq)
  weak   →  weakEN    (kuchsizlantirmoq)

  Sifatdan FE'L yasaydi.


IKKI MAQOL BIR-BIRIGA ZIDMI?
  1-maqol: yolg'iz yur — tez yetasan
  2-maqol: sayohat qil — aqling kengayadi

  Zid emas: birinchisi TEZLIK haqida,
  ikkinchisi FOYDA haqida.

  Lekin qiziq: birinchisi yolg'izlikni
  maqtaydi, ikkinchisi esa sayohatning
  o'zini.


BOG'LIQLIK — UNIT MAVZUSI:
  Butun Unit 15 SAYOHAT haqida (Qohira,
  Madrid, Parij, Amerika mehmonxonalari).

  Bu maqollar unitni yakunlaydi: sayohat
  nima uchun qilinadi degan savolga javob.


DIQQAT — MAQOLLAR TARJIMA QILINMAYDI:
  Har tilda O'Z muqobili bor. So'zma-so'z
  o'girish ko'pincha ma'nosiz bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to travel  = sayohat qilmoq
  travel     = sayohat (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  fastest    = eng tez
  alone      = yolg'iz
  to broaden = kengaytirmoq
  broad      = keng
  the mind   = ong, aql
  wisdom     = donishmandlik
